Concept redesign of a fictional plumber. Not a client project.

Someone with water on the floor wants one thing: a number to call. This homepage hides it, leads with a stock handshake and asks for 12 fields. The fix: a call button that stays on screen, the licence number up top, a 3-field quote form and real job photos.

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional plumber's homepage, rebuilt for someone with water on the floor.

Before: no phone number on the first screen, a stock photo of an office handshake, a 12-field quote form with a 2 to 3 day reply, and no licence number anywhere.

After: a call button that stays on screen, the licence number up top, 3 fields for a fixed price, and photos of real work.

Not a client project. Happy to look at yours: prycedigital.com/book
